# Project Governance (Docs)

Canonical governance belongs in the root repository. This document summarizes documentation decisions.

## Roles

- Maintainers merge pull requests, publish docs, and keep navigation coherent.
- Contributors open issues and pull requests, fix examples, and help review translations.
- Reviewers may provide focused feedback on shells, platform behavior, localization, or site design.

## Decision making

- Small doc fixes can be merged after basic review.
- Navigation, information architecture, or theme changes should receive maintainer review.
- Policy documents mirror the root repository and should be changed centrally.

## Transparency

Substantial decisions should be captured in pull request descriptions or linked issues.

## Evolution

As rpath grows, this summary can be replaced by a formal charter in the root repository.
